scope: Neutral schema based on observed categories of field paperwork; NOT the employer's original templates or ElmTree schema.
sensitive_data_policy: Use synthetic identifiers in public demos. Employee, client, and job information from originals must not be included.
confidence_policy: Image-derived fields are UNVERIFIED until a human compares them against authorized original evidence. Confidence scores are advisory only.

general_report.name: Daily General Report
general_report.count_semantics: Counts reflect each explicitly named activity, not necessarily every test recorded in other sheets. Blank is unknown rather than zero.

concrete_strength.name: Concrete field / compressive strength sheet
concrete_strength.count_semantics: Unfilled laboratory age marks are not proof that cylinders were tested or picked up. Cast, pickup, received, and tested events are distinct.

density_sheet.name: In-place density (continued pages)
density_sheet.page_policy: Only combine explicitly matching series and page metadata. Do not equate duplicate station with duplicate test. Blank continuation row is not a test.

rebar_observation.name: Rebar observation / inspection
rebar_observation.review_policy: Qualitative comments and as-built observations require qualified human interpretation, not automated compliance judgment.

measurement_notes.field_wet_density_pcf: Density in lb/ft^3; physical/QA plausibility only, not method-specific acceptance.
measurement_notes.field_dry_density_pcf: Check wet/(1+w_fraction) where moisture % is dry-mass-based moisture ratio; check the instrument/method definition before using.
measurement_notes.reported_compaction_percent: Check 100*dry/reference max dry, but do not assign a pass/fail unless project requirements explicitly reviewed.
measurement_notes.slump_in: Inches; do not infer compliance from a global range.
measurement_notes.air_percent: Air percent; only comparison to source or authorized job specification.
measurement_notes.unit_load_psi: Requires checked lab age, specimen geometry, corrected load, and approved method.
